property.name: isRelatedList
property.label: Is Related List
property.description: Mark it to show the component as related list

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Id of the record where the data will be pulled from

property.name: relatedfieldname
property.label: Related field API name
property.description: API name of the Lookup/MD field

property.name: searchAvailable
property.label: Enable Search
property.description: Set to true to enable search bar

property.name: searchFieldList
property.label: Field Search List
property.description: Comma separated API names of the fields to search on. Kepp in mind like operator only valid on string field

property.name: sortedbylist
property.label: Order by
property.description: API name of the field to use to order the list

property.name: sortedDir
property.label: Sort direction
property.description: Specifies whether the list is ordered in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order by the Order by field. Default order is ascending. Only works if Order by is set

property.name: rowLimit
property.label: Limit of rows
property.description: Number of maximum rows to show in the component.

property.name: pageLimit
property.label: Limit of rows per page
property.description: Number of maximum rows to show per page.

property.name: detailpage
property.label: Detail Page Base URL
property.description: Set a base url for the detail page to redirect to
